column1: # Turkish (tr) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty           a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code (`tl!("…")`,
#                            a menu label, or a name the UI translates with `i18n::t`)
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns;
#            translators may reorder them. A trailing "…" (dialog commands) is kept.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English text using ordinary
# Turkish video-editing vocabulary (iz, oynatma kafası, sekans, havuz,
# giriş/çıkış noktası, anahtar kare, işleme…). No proprietary localisation resource, string
# table or product UI was consulted or copied, and no other FilmCraft catalog was translated from;
# add entries the same way. Product, technology and format names (FilmCraft, ArtCraft, Lumetri,
# ProRes, LUFS, H.264…) keep their spelling, as do key-cap names (Shift, Alt, Ctrl, Cmd, Opt, Esc).
# Commands are imperatives addressed with "tu"; decimals use a comma (29,97 fps).
